features: 45W Super Fast Charging (USB-C PD 3.0): Get lightning-fast charging with Samsung’s original 45W USB-C Super Fast Charger. Perfect for powering your Galaxy S25 Ultra, S24 Ultra, Z Fold 7, Z Flip 7, and more in record time.

Safe & Reliable Charging Technology: Built-in safeguards protect against overheating, over-current, and over-voltage, ensuring safe charging for all Samsung Galaxy smartphones, tablets, and foldables.
Compatible Beyond Smartphones: Also works with Samsung Galaxy Tablets, Chromebooks, and other USB-C gadgets, making it a single charger solution for all your devices.
